title: Michael's Role: Operations & Leadership
description: How well do you understand how RCRS actually runs? Test your knowledge of business operations, metrics, team management, and CRM workflows.

questions.question: What CRM does RCRS use to manage leads, jobs, and the sales pipeline?
questions.explanation: JobNimbus is our CRM. Everything flows through it — leads, inspections, contingencies, approvals, closed jobs. If it's not in JobNimbus, it didn't happen.

questions.question: What's the correct JobNimbus pipeline order for a typical insurance restoration job?
questions.explanation: The pipeline flows: Lead → Inspection → Contingency → Approved → Closed. Each stage has specific actions and documentation requirements. Skipping stages means lost data and messy tracking.

questions.question: How often are team sales meetings held?
questions.explanation: Weekly sales meetings. This is where the team shares strategies, reviews numbers, discusses challenges, and stays aligned. Attendance isn't optional — it's how top teams stay top teams.

questions.question: What was RCRS's total team revenue in 2024?
questions.explanation: $3,631,861.60 across 1,778 inspections. The top 3 reps alone generated $1.75 million (48.2% of total). Knowing the numbers helps you understand the business and set realistic goals.

questions.question: How are sales rep commissions classified for tax purposes?
questions.explanation: All sales reps are 1099 independent contractors, and payments are classified as 1099-NEC. This means reps handle their own taxes, but their earning potential is uncapped.

questions.question: How often are commissions paid out?
questions.explanation: Weekly payouts based on week-ending dates. Commissions are triggered when jobs are paid and closed in the system. The portal and JobNimbus both track commission status.

questions.question: What does a Division Leader earn in addition to standard commission?
options: Nothing extra — it's just a title
questions.explanation: Division Leaders receive a monthly bonus payment on top of standard commission. It's an additional leadership role for senior reps who mentor the team and drive results in their territory.

questions.question: What tool does RCRS use for aerial roof measurements?
options: A tape measure from the ground
questions.explanation: EagleView provides accurate aerial measurements for estimating. It's used for getting roof dimensions, creating estimates, verifying insurance company measurements, and planning material orders.

questions.question: Which lead source had the HIGHEST conversion rate in 2024?
questions.explanation: Previous customers converted at 75%! They already trust you. This is why customer follow-up and post-job communication matter so much. Never forget a past client.

questions.question: The referral ecosystem (Referral + Personal + BNI + Insurance Agent + Realtor) generated how much in 2024?
questions.explanation: Over $1.6 million came from the referral ecosystem. This is why RCRS pushes relationship-building so hard. Every closed deal should generate at least one referral ask.

questions.question: What's the RCRS portal used for? (Select the BEST answer)
options: Commission tracking, training, storm reports, roof measurements, team performance, scheduling
questions.explanation: The portal (RoofStack) is the central hub — commissions, training modules, storm reports/hail maps, roof measurements, team performance dashboards, and scheduling. It's not just a payroll tool.

questions.question: What separates the top 3 reps' revenue from each other in 2024?
questions.explanation: Less than $8,000 separated the top 3 reps ($587K, $584K, $580K). The difference between #1 and #3 was razor thin. Consistency and one or two extra deals can mean the difference between first and third.
